message:
You know that sinking feeling when your phone dies just when you need it most? I had that experience recently during a storm warning. Thankfully, I had some old-school strategies to fall back on, but I couldn’t help but think how handy it would’ve been to have a solid plan in place. 

If you’re like me and don’t want to be caught off guard when the skies turn gray, it’s worth checking out some resources on storm preparedness. It’s always better to be ready than to wing it when things get a little dicey. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying calm and prepared during a storm? 🌩️
